war_summary: War 139 is on day 119 with no winner, and strategic-base activity is concentrated on a handful of contested fronts. Endless Shore is the most volatile region, with 53 ownership events in 24 hours, six in the last two hours, rapidly accelerating casualties and enlistments, and an 8–2 Colonial advantage. Oarbreaker has also experienced heavy churn at 39 events, though its activity has cooled recently and all nine bases are currently Warden-held. Godcrofts remains highly unstable with 25 events, six in the last six hours, three Warden bases, five Colonial bases, and one neutral base. Clahstra has intense, accelerating combat and enlistment rates alongside 11 recent ownership events and a 6–2 Warden lead. Stema Landing has the freshest activity, including three events in the last two hours, while Callahan’s Passage combines six recent events with the war’s heaviest casualty totals and accelerating combat on a 6–4 Warden–Colonial split. Most other regions show no recent base flips and comparatively low front-line activity.
